dict.string: Hourly heartbeat for /Volumes/DockVault (mount + active write-test round-trip). Per Charlie's 2026-08-23 D3=3b ruling: active write-test catches exact silent-hang class where mount is present but volume is inaccessible (FDA gap, Spotlight lock, half-unlocked keychain). Missing heartbeat -> BetterStack alerts. RunAtLoad TRUE: pulse on reboot to catch post-boot keychain-unlock issues immediately. DOCKVAULT_MONITOR_HEARTBEAT_URL must be set in env for ping to fire.
